days.title: Northern Shore and Water Fun
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Attersee Water Park
stops.detail: The Attersee Water Park combines beach and outdoor pool: a heated pool (26 °C), slides into the lake, a white-water channel, a geyser, massage jets and a waterfall.

stops.name: Seewalchen
stops.detail: Sport, dirndls, and Klimt – Seewalchen has much to offer beyond its lakeshore.

stops.name: Schörfling
stops.detail: Restaurant Langostinos in Schörfling: 1 toque, regional fish specialities.

stops.name: Weyregg Lido
stops.detail: At Weyregg Lido, you'll find a sunbathing lawn, a jetty, a children's area with a solar-heated pool, a floating island, and a café on the catamaran.

stops.name: Nixenfall
stops.detail: Today, a sculpture at the Nixenfall in Steinbach commemorates her.

stops.name: Attersee-Traunsee Star Park
stops.detail: The Attersee-Traunsee Star Park – Austria's first Dark Sky Park – stands for the conscious use of light at night.
